anyOf.description: Number of files changed by the candidate. Null means: The candidate diff could not be enumerated.
Number of added lines in the candidate diff. Null means: Directional diff statistics were unavailable.
Number of deleted lines in the candidate diff. Null means: Directional diff statistics were unavailable.
Total added plus deleted lines in the candidate diff. Null means: The candidate diff could not be measured.
Maximum dependency-graph depth reached by changed modules. Null means: No supported dependency graph could be derived.
Repository-history hotspot score for changed modules. Null means: Sufficient repository history was unavailable.
Whether diff parsing produced internally suspicious measurements. Null means: No diff analysis was attempted.
Type-check errors reported for the candidate. Null means: No supported type checker completed successfully.
Lint errors reported for the candidate. Null means: No supported linter completed successfully.
Whether the configured build completed successfully. Null means: No build ran to a terminal result or collection failed.
Candidate-minus-base change in the configured code-complexity metric. Null means: No supported complexity analyzer completed on both revisions.
Whether the candidate adds or modifies test files. Null means: Test files could not be classified from the diff.
Fraction of executed tests that passed. Null means: No supported test result completed with a measurable rate.
Elapsed seconds for the candidate test execution. Null means: Test runtime was not reported.
Coarse category of the requested change. Null means: No task category could be derived without guessing.
Dominant implementation language category. Null means: No supported dominant language could be derived.
Coarse product or engineering domain category. Null means: No domain evidence was available; do not default to backend.
Normalized estimated task complexity on the Hokusai 0–10 scale. Null means: Complexity could not be derived without a fallback.
Bucketed repository size. Null means: Repository size could not be measured.
Bucketed number of files changed by the candidate. Null means: The candidate diff could not be enumerated.
Bucketed length of the locally inspected task description. Null means: No task description was available to classify locally.
Whether the task creates a new subsystem rather than changing one. Null means: The change kind could not be classified.
Whether the task includes a schema or data migration. Null means: Migration intent could not be classified.
Whether the task intent requires test work. Null means: Test intent could not be classified.
Whether the task spans multiple services or repositories. Null means: Service scope could not be classified.
Whether UI work is a substantial part of the task. Null means: UI intent could not be classified.
Coarse locally derived implementation-risk category. Null means: Risk could not be classified from bounded derived signals.
Number of changed files outside the authoritative task scope. Null means: No task scope authority existed or the scope guard errored.
Number of recorded human interventions before arbitration. Null means: Intervention collection was unavailable.
Number of distinct pre-arbitration human review rounds. Null means: Review history was unavailable.
Number of pre-arbitration change-request reviews. Null means: Review history was unavailable.
Number of recorded automated self-review repair iterations. Null means: Self-review iteration telemetry was unavailable.
Number of recorded implementation iterations before arbitration. Null means: Implementation iteration telemetry was unavailable.
